purpose: Standardize evidence capture for CGX-LAUNCH-007 and CGX-LAUNCH-008 without allowing a single-host or synthetic fixture to close physical, peer, production-keystore, recovery, or governance gates.
invariants: preflight evidence never promotes child or distributed authority
one physical host never satisfies the two-distinct-device predicate
mounted storage or a second path on one host never counts as a distinct compute node
loopback traffic never satisfies non-loopback peer transport
synthetic credential tests never prove production credential integration
raw machine identifiers, IP addresses, usernames, passwords, tokens, credential blobs and recovery secrets are excluded from receipts
only irreversible-hardened hashes or categorical host metadata may identify a host in portable receipts
credential probes use newly generated synthetic material and must clean it up before PASS
failure to clean up synthetic credential material is a failed preflight
revocation and degraded-mode receipts must demonstrate fail-closed authority behavior
empirical closure requires independent Achilles audit after provider/host readback

preflight_may_prove: one-host identity fingerprint without raw machine identifier
local runtime and node-exchange contract availability
non-loopback network capability exists on the host
receipt schema and negative-claim boundaries are ready
closure_requires: two genuinely distinct physical device fingerprints
authenticated non-loopback discovery and transfer between those devices
exact transfer readback on the receiver
identity and scoped execution-lease readback on both nodes
revocation/stop propagation across the peer boundary
partition/degraded-mode test showing no authority manufacture
independent audit of the complete evidence set

preflight_may_prove: target host exposes an OS credential protection/storage boundary
synthetic secret can be written and read back without secret disclosure
closure_requires: production-relevant LightSpeed/CGX credential integration uses the approved platform boundary
revocation is exercised through the production-relevant integration
recovery is exercised through the approved recovery path without exposing secret material
target host classes in scope are individually evidenced
no secret appears in Git, Drive, logs or portable receipts
independent audit of capability and cleanup
